# §5 Commerce Analytics — Highlight Candidates

1. **50.2% GMV capture positions eCat as primary transaction system** — eCat captured $9.0M of $17.8M in all-channel GMV trailing 12 months, with order capture at 42.0%, reflecting proportionally higher-value transactions flowing through the platform. [→ §commerce]
2. **eCat Online drives 79.7% of order volume via buyer self-service** — 4,969 of 6,232 eCat orders originated from eCat Online trailing 12 months, generating $5.8M in GMV while iPad handled higher-value transactions at 2.1× the average order value. [→ §commerce]
3. **Q1 2026 marks strongest eCat quarter with 25.2% GMV growth** — 1,725 orders generated $2.5M in eCat GMV in Q1 2026, up from 1,541 orders and $2.0M in Q4 2025. [→ §commerce]
4. **Buyer base is well-distributed with no concentration risk** — Top 5 buyers account for just 10.6% of eCat GMV and top 10 for 13.4% trailing 12 months, indicating broad platform adoption across the account base. [→ §commerce]

## Priority Action Candidate
- **MEDIUM**: Explore pathways to route more all-channel order volume through eCat — at 42.0% order capture vs. 50.2% GMV capture, there is potential to increase order count penetration which could add an estimated $2–4M in additional captured GMV annually [HYPOTHETICAL]. [→ §commerce]
